research_question: What is the next nonduplicated high-information fail-closed discriminator after bounded native llama.cpp cvec component evidence, while preventing lexical, output-code, operating-point, token-scope and generic-compliance confounds from being promoted as semantic J-Space evidence?

observed_counterexample.finding: The existing native semantic-counterbalanced executor is still AFFIRMATIVE-only at the requested semantic target level: calibration and fresh holdout remap AFFIRMATIVE across A/B/C, while its model-facing semantic basis explicitly contains AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL pole names and nearby lexical synonyms.
observed_counterexample.implication: Output-code counterbalance can remove a direct A/B/C code preference but cannot by itself separate semantic specificity from lexical-axis reconstruction or generic requested-code/instruction-compliance uplift.

counterhypotheses: A positive +VECTOR effect is generic instruction compliance, confidence or task engagement rather than target-specific semantic causality.
A direction that appears semantic is reconstructed from target words and nearby synonyms present in model-facing basis prompts.
Apparent success is an artifact of raw gain or holdout-sensitive operating-point selection rather than comparable intervention strength.
Native llama.cpp cvec and prior PyTorch results differ because their intervention token scopes differ, not because the same causal mechanism replicated.
A pooled mean hides unstable or sign-reversing effects across lexical families.
Target improvement is purchased by off-target behavioral drift rather than a selective semantic intervention.

parallel_fusion.commit_message: research: implement Trigger-1 semantic simplex rank discriminator
parallel_fusion.reason: The parallel tool is calibration-only/source-only rank metrology for label-free lexically disjoint activation families and explicitly does not run a model or open holdout. It informs whether a one-dimensional contrast or a two-dimensional centered simplex is justified, but does not itself enforce end-to-end promotion metrology.

new_required_controls: lexical nuisance projection/control with bound receipt
semantic-target x output-code factorial design in calibration and holdout
operating point selected on calibration only and frozen before holdout
off-target drift test against a preregistered frozen threshold
native llama.cpp cvec classified as ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS rather than silently claimed as strict last-token replication

external_research.source: Wu, Zhao, Chen (2026), When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs, arXiv:2608.08159
external_research.finding_used: Raw activation units, readout metric and operating point can materially change steering interpretation; residual-norm-comparable interventions and held-out operating-point selection improve measurement comparability.
external_research.design_consequence: Require residual-norm-relative intervention magnitude and calibration-only operating-point selection frozen before holdout.

external_research.source: Braun et al. (2025), Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models, arXiv:2505.22637
external_research.finding_used: Steering has high per-sample variance and more coherent activation-difference directions predict more effective steering.
external_research.design_consequence: Require cross-family direction-coherence evidence and preserve per-family interaction evidence.

external_research.source: Tan et al. (2024), Analyzing the Generalization and Reliability of Steering Vectors, arXiv:2407.12404
external_research.finding_used: Steering can exhibit spurious in-distribution bias and brittle out-of-distribution behavior under reasonable prompt changes.
external_research.design_consequence: Use lexically disjoint families, fresh holdout and explicit off-target drift controls.

fused_next_exact_discriminator.name: LABEL_FREE_TARGET_X_CODE_COUNTERBALANCED_SCOPE_EXPLICIT_NORM_CALIBRATED_NATIVE_CVEC/v1
steps: Generate calibration-only model-facing-label-free activation families with lexical disjointness and exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime identities.
Run the semantic simplex rank discriminator before choosing a one-axis vs rank-2 representation; keep holdout unopened.
Construct the chosen internal direction/subspace with lexical nuisance projection/control and bind its receipt.
Select residual-norm-relative operating point on calibration only.
Freeze target x code factorial metric, per-family interaction, coherence and off-target thresholds before holdout.
Execute pinned GGUF plus pinned llama.cpp llama_set_adapter_cvec with BASELINE, +VECTOR, SIGN_FLIP, NULL_VECTOR, ORTHOGONAL_SAME_NORM, PERMUTED_SAME_NORM and LABEL_ONLY_NUISANCE_VECTOR.
Open only fresh lexically disjoint AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL x A/B/C holdout after calibration acceptance.
Submit the bound candidate to v4 and then v5; any v4 failure or v5 specificity failure blocks owner promotion.
fused_next_exact_discriminator.positive_pattern: +VECTOR yields preregistered target-specific interactions across fresh families; SIGN_FLIP reverses them; null/orthogonal/permuted/label-only nuisance controls do not reproduce them; coherence passes; off-target drift remains below frozen threshold.
fused_next_exact_discriminator.negative_pattern: Generic uplift across all requested semantic targets, lexical-family collapse, low coherence, holdout-sensitive operating-point selection, scope mismatch, nuisance-vector reproduction or excessive off-target drift rejects semantic-specific promotion.

evidence_boundary: This run adds source-level scientific promotion hardening and a durable research fusion only. Source and test presence are not test execution. No new model/runtime/J-Space/HCU/EntityOS/training/canonical-semantics credit is minted. Existing bounded native cvec component evidence remains bounded component evidence.
